relatedBills.title: Family and Medical Leave Act of 1989

latestAction.text: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.

relatedBills.title: Providing for the consideration of the bill (H.R. 770) to entitle employees to family leave in certain cases involving a birth, an adoption, or a serious health condition and to temporary medical leave in certain cases involving a serious health condition, with adequate protection of the employees' employment and benefit rights, and to establish a commission to study ways of providing salary replacement for employees who take any such leave.
